free_parameters.name: num_q_heads
free_parameters.why: head count is absent from the witness hint; the dtype assertion reads q.dtype only, not the head dimensions

free_parameters.name: num_kv_heads
free_parameters.why: KV head count is absent from the witness hint; one KV head equals one query head so the downstream GQA divisibility check is trivially satisfied

free_parameters.name: gamma
free_parameters.why: required positional coverage ratio not in the witness hint; the dtype assertion is evaluated before gamma is used on either dispatch path

free_parameters.name: gqa_interleave
free_parameters.why: routes the q_len == 1 entry branch through the real triton_flash_attention, which contains the target assertion, instead of the GPU flash_attn_func

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed RNG seed for deterministic tensor construction across repeats and the clean-checkout replay

mocks.reason: GPU-only Triton decode launcher reached by the negative input after it passes the target dtype assertion; a plain-torch attention replaces only that post-target call
